intro: Today's tech landscape highlights shifting economic expectations and aggressive pricing strategies within the AI industry. We are also seeing new friction emerge as communities and publishers navigate the integration of AI tools.

must_know.title: OpenAI and Anthropic cut their LLM prices by up to 80% within a few months. Why?
must_know.summary: Leading AI labs, including OpenAI and Anthropic, have aggressively reduced pricing for their large language models by up to 80% over the last few months.
must_know.why_it_matters: Rapid price erosion suggests intense competition for API market share and improved compute efficiency.

must_know.title: Google’s AI search changes upended online publishing
must_know.summary: Google's implementation of AI-driven search results has significantly disrupted the traditional digital publishing industry's reliance on standard search traffic.
must_know.why_it_matters: AI-led search changes are forcing a fundamental shift in how web publishers monetize content.

must_know.title: AI delivers ‘zero financial payoff’ to most companies, Apollo economist says
must_know.summary: Apollo's chief economist suggests that outside of the technology sector, artificial intelligence has yet to yield significant financial returns for corporations despite substantial investments.
must_know.why_it_matters: It highlights a potential disconnect between corporate AI spending and actual productivity gains.

research.title: A 10-year-old CNN outperforms frontier LLMs for skin cancer diagnosis
research.summary: A study indicates that a ten-year-old convolutional neural network (CNN) can outperform modern, state-of-the-art LLMs in the specialized task of skin cancer diagnosis.
research.why_it_matters: It underscores that massive language models are not always the optimal solution for specific domain-expert diagnostic tasks.

open-source.title: r/opensource just banned AI, non-English speakers, and more
open-source.summary: The moderators of the r/opensource subreddit have implemented new rules that prohibit projects related to or generated by artificial intelligence.
open-source.why_it_matters: This reflects the ongoing tension within developer communities regarding the role of AI in open-source software.
